QuestInfo.name: [Home] A Brand New Home
QuestInfo.0: Kenneth told you your house seemed pretty cramped, and suggested you visit him for some help. Could it be he wants to help you expand?
QuestInfo.1:
Alvin and Amy accompanied you on a visit to Kenneth's house, which was full of rare furnishings. Then Alvin informed you that you could #byou can obtain unique furnishings by defeating boss monsters#k. 


Kenneth gave you a #bCozy Mushroom House Blueprint#k as a belated housewarming gift. Go back to the your house and renovate!


#e#b[Tip: Building]#n
1. Double-click a blueprint from your inventory to add it to your list of available renovations.
2. Click the  #i3801390# button in the Home menu to open the Build window. 
3. Click the design you want to build using the menu on the right. Select your choice of roofs, exterior walls, and windows, then click the [Apply] button.
